stem:
The speed of an object over time is shown in the graph.

[Graph titled Speed vs. Time with vertical axis Speed (m/s) from 0 to 7 and horizontal axis Time (s) from 0 to 25. The graph line rises steeply from (0,0) to (3,7), remains constant at speed 7 from time 3 to 18, then decreases steeply back to 0 at time 23.]

Which table describes the object's motion?

options.label: F
options.text:
Time Interval (s) | Description of the Motion
0-3  | The object's speed is increasing.
3-18 | The object's speed is constant.
18-23| The object's speed is decreasing.

options.label: H
options.text:
Time Interval (s) | Description of the Motion
0-3  | The object's speed is increasing.
3-18 | The object is at rest.
18-23| The object's speed is decreasing.

options.label: G
options.text:
Time Interval (s) | Description of the Motion
0-3  | The object is moving in a positive direction.
3-18 | The object is at rest.
18-23| The object is moving in a negative direction.

options.label: J
options.text:
Time Interval (s) | Description of the Motion
0-3  | The object is moving at a constant speed.
3-18 | The object is at rest.
18-23| The object is moving at a constant speed.

visual_elements: Graph Speed vs. Time with speed (m/s) on vertical axis and time (s) on horizontal axis with a line rising from 0 to 7 m/s between 0 and 3 s, constant at 7 m/s between 3 and 18 s, and descending from 7 to 0 m/s between 18 and 23 s.
